meta.status: PILOT — evaluation of experimental stage_b_pilot exports; no production change, nothing committed

design.pool: 15 frozen Stage-A exports (5 algorithms × 3 seeds, incl. the learner's own algorithm)
design.ruleBots: 4 frozen rule seats always + RL seats on rule fallback (≥ 4/9)
design.init: warm start from each seed's frozen Stage-A final checkpoint; fresh optimizer; D3QN/QR-DQN ε constant at the Stage-A final value, empty replay
design.seeds: run seeds 101/102/103 ← Stage-A seeds 1/2/3 (train split only)
design.budget: 497,664 learner decisions per seed (ES: first generation boundary at or after it)
design.evaluation: c100/c250: validation entries 0–99; c500: all 500 (Phase 2E.0 protocol)

definitions.pairing: Stage-B c500 episode vs the frozen Stage-A export of the same algorithm and seed index, same condition, opponent export and entry (40 Phase 2E.2 entries)
definitions.earlyStarBidShare: share of the learner's star decisions before 30% of the main round where it bid (cap ≥ base)
definitions.keeperPassAffordableNeeded: keeper-lot decisions with an unmet keeper need, maxSafeBid ≥ base, and action PASS
definitions.expensiveLateBuys: purchases at ≥ 75% main-round progress (or re-auction) at ≥ 1.5 × fair value
definitions.purseAtFirstCritical: own purse share at the first decision whose shield state is CRITICAL or IMPOSSIBLE
